title: feat(web): tag pull requests with the author's kind and add a First-timers view
body:
Stacked on #150.

Mockup D tags each pull request with who opened it and offers a first-time contributors view. The portal showed neither.

## What changed

- Hub: the open pull requests route returns `authorKind` per row (owner, member, collaborator, contributor, first-timer, outside, bot), folded in the hub from GitHub's author association and account type through the contract's `authorKindOf`; the raw fields never leave the hub. The route's response is described row by row; `sha` is optional as returned.
- Portal: a tag before the title on every inbox row and after the author in the pane byline. First-timer and Bot use the normal tag; other kinds use a muted one; no tag when GitHub did not say. Each tag has a title and a hidden "Author:" prefix.
- A First-timers view at `/first-timers` beside Needs you and All open, sharing All open's rows and triage-enabled filter, with its count in the rail and the mobile nav (now five columns, "Repos").
- The GitHub tool's open pull request listing carries the two source fields, covered by the 0.3.1 bump on #150.

## Verification

- `bun run check`; `bun test apps/web` (view filter, counts, handled rows); `bun --conditions=intx-src test apps/hub/src/server.test.ts`.
- Browser pass on a local hub and portal with a fake GitHub: a first-timer PR shows the tag in the list and the pane, the rail counts "First-timers 1" and the view lists only it; the five-column mobile nav fits at 360px.

Closes CL-XXXX
